reason: This text is the Akedah narrative (Genesis 22), which describes God's covenant renewal with Abraham after testing his faith. The passage culminates in God swearing an oath to bless Abraham's descendants abundantly and multiply them like the stars of heaven and sand of the seashore. It emphasizes God's loyalty and commitment to Abraham and his offspring ('I will bless you and multiply your seed'), not any withdrawal of loyalty or consideration of replacement with another people. The passage demonstrates God's fidelity to the covenant relationship, not abandonment of it.
